Målet är att ge europeiska bolag bättre förutsättningar att nå den skala som krävs för att överleva mot världens teknologiska och industriella ledare från USA och Kina.

en.title: New EU rules pave the way for European mega-mergers
en.summary: Before the year's end, the EU's reformed merger rules enter into force to make it easier for more deals in the multi-billion range. The aim is to give European companies better conditions to reach the scale needed to survive against the technological and industrial leaders of the United States and China.

sv.title: Storförvärvaren: ”Bolagen ser oss som det vinnande laget”

en.title: Acquisition giant: "Companies see us as the winning team"

sv.title: Nya trenden: Carve-outs

en.title: New trend: carve-outs
en.summary: More and more companies choose to sell parts of their operations that no longer fit the core business. Carve-outs are now singled out as one of this year's strongest M&A trends, with private equity firms in the lead.

sv.title: Vittring på nya byten – hon vässar klorna i Vimians förvärvsjakt

en.title: Scent of new prey – she sharpens her claws in Vimian's acquisition hunt
